title: From ODD Expansion to WSAL-2→3 Transition in Shaping Hydropower
journal: Water Resources Research / Control Engineering Practice

history.key_changes: Initialized P2E draft skeleton with CHS-consistent equations, WSAL-2→3 scope, and ODD/xIL governance placeholders.
Added ODD go/no-go gates, measurable WSAL-2→3 criteria, minimal evidence package, bounded fallback requirement, and scope boundary statement.
Added bounded contribution statement, WSAL transition governance matrix, and cross-paper linkage notes while preserving equations/symbols.
Added explicit Eq.(2) validity assumptions, model-layer acceptance rule, and falsifiable gate metrics with strict fail condition.
Added scenario taxonomy with mandatory class coverage, operator go/no-go checklist, and audit traceability table tied to SCADA-valid fallback verification.
Added impact-positioning boundary, responsible-autonomy human-role definition, iteration-5 reference verification note, and cross-paper differentiation guardrail.
Formalized WSAL promotion predicate (Eq.3), mapped Eq.(2) assumptions to gate-failure logic, and added non-compensability safety rule with requalification requirements.
Added shift-level activation protocol, communication degradation stress envelope, and operational campaign closure criteria with explicit open/acceptable states.
Added multi-stakeholder transparency layer, bounded transferability prerequisites, and public-interest safety communication categories (safe success/hold/downgrade).
Added decision-state invariants (PROMOTE/HOLD/DOWNGRADE), contradiction-check audit rule, and minimal executable checklist for Eq.(3) gate aggregation.
Added runtime authority handoff protocol, alarm triage/escalation matrix, and mandatory post-shift closure package requirements for audit continuity.
Added transfer-readiness scorecard (TR-1~TR-3), mandatory negative-result disclosure, and bounded novelty statement versus P1a/P2A/P2D to tighten accountability and cross-paper distinction.
Introduced freshness constraint for gate evidence (Eq.4), freshness-aware promotion predicate (Eq.5), and monotonic invalidation/requalification rule under configuration drift.
Added minimum live-observation window before promotion, rollback SLO constraint (Eq.6) tied to fallback gate failure, and multi-shift handover continuity package requirements.
Added public decision reporting template, transfer-governance maturity tiers (T1/T2/T3), and formal non-promotion validity statement (Eq.7) for safety-first accountability.

Expanded ProtocolComplete into formal subconditions (Eq.8), defined SafetyPreserved predicate (Eq.9), and added decision-predicate non-contradiction implication for valid non-promotion outcomes (Eq.10).
Added non-authoritative campaign readiness index (Eq.11), post-downgrade requalification window, and campaign handback checklist while preserving Eq.(5) as sole promotion criterion.
Added cross-cycle learning ledger requirement, external communication boundary statements, and completion-readiness governance indicator (Eq.12) tied to traceability and archival artifacts.
Added traceability completeness predicate (Eq.13), closure non-regression constraint (Eq.14), and pre-final governance readiness implication (Eq.15) to tighten final-stage audit consistency.
Added pre-activation shift-freeze package, alarm-to-authority closure predicate (Eq.16), and deployment-governance compatibility note preserving Eq.(5).
Added responsible dissemination package, publication-readiness predicate (Eq.17), and iteration-exit completion statement for project handoff.
